Battleship.name: Battleship
Battleship.summary: Battleship is a game based off of the film, based off of the board game/toy.

Hajime no Ippo - The Fighting!.name: Hajime no Ippo: The Fighting!
Hajime no Ippo - The Fighting!.summary: Boxing manga/anime franchise Hajime no Ippo returns for the PS3. The game is a third-person fighting game following the Hajime no Ippo story.

PES 2013 - Pro Evolution Soccer.name: Pro Evolution Soccer 2013
PES 2013 - Pro Evolution Soccer.summary: Pro Evolution Soccer 2013 (also known as World Soccer: Winning Eleven 2013 in Japan and South Korea) is an association football video game part of the Pro Evolution Soccer series, developed and published by Konami.

Worms Collection.name: Worms Collection
Worms Collection.summary: Worms Collection is a collection of three video games in the Worms series developed by Team17. It contained Worms (2007), Worms 2: Armageddon and Worms Ultimate Mayhem. It also contained six bonus DLCs. The collection was released on 31 August 2012 for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360.[1]
